TERMS OF SERVICE

Clear terms for a clear service.

These terms apply to this website and to the Reconcile Ready service.

UPDATED 18 NOVEMBER 2026

About these terms

Reconcile Ready is operated by J5 Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales (company number [COMPANY NUMBER]), registered office [REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS]. Contact: hello@reconcileready.app. By using the website or the service, you agree to these terms.

The service

Reconcile Ready is being developed to help ecommerce sellers and their accountants consolidate Amazon, eBay and Shopify financial activity, prepare entries for Xero and measure product and channel profitability. Features, availability, pricing and supported regions will be confirmed before launch and may change.

Your account and authorisations

  • You must be authorised to connect every Amazon, eBay or Shopify account and Xero organisation you link.
  • Accountants connecting a client’s accounts must have that client’s permission.
  • Keep your sign-in details secure and tell us promptly about any unauthorised use.
  • You can revoke platform or Xero access at any time.

Your data

You own your data. We process it only to provide the service, as described in our privacy policy and Amazon data use page. Where we process personal data on your behalf, we act as your processor and the data processing terms below apply.

Data processing terms

  • We process customer personal data only on your documented instructions, which are these terms and your use of the service.
  • Our staff with access are bound by confidentiality.
  • We apply the security measures described on our security page.
  • We use only the sub-processors listed in our privacy policy, and give notice before adding new ones.
  • We help you respond to data subject requests and notify you without undue delay of any personal data breach.
  • When the service ends, we delete your data within 30 days unless the law requires us to keep it.

Acceptable use

Do not use the service to break the law, breach a connected platform’s terms, access accounts you are not authorised to use, or interfere with the service’s security or operation.

Accounting and tax

Reconcile Ready prepares information to help your bookkeeping. You remain responsible for reviewing entries before posting, and for your accounts and tax returns. The service is not accounting, tax or legal advice.

Third-party platforms

Amazon, eBay, Shopify and Xero are independent companies. Their names identify planned integrations and do not mean they endorse Reconcile Ready. Service availability depends on their platforms, permissions and terms.

Liability

We provide the service with reasonable care and skill. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law. Otherwise, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, and our total liability is limited to the fees you paid in the 12 months before the claim.

Ending the service

You can stop using the service and close your account at any time. We may suspend access if these terms are breached or if required to protect the service, a connected platform or other users.

Law

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have jurisdiction.
